2610.10447.title: A Good Self-Teacher Meets the Student Where They Are: Joint On-Policy Learning and Teaching
2610.10447.paper_summary: Reinforcement Learning (RL) from outcome rewards suffers from sparse supervision, particularly on difficult, long-horizon tasks where successful trajectories are rare and costly to generate. On-Policy Distillation (OPD) offers an attractive alternative by providing dense token-level supervision from a stronger teacher along the student's own generations. Self-distillation methods further remove the need for a separate teacher model by conditioning the same policy on privileged information to serve as its own teacher. However, privileged conditioning alone does not guarantee that the resulting distillation update improves the student. Indeed, privileged information can lead the teacher to solve tasks through shortcuts unavailable to the student, producing supervision poorly matched to the student's current behavior. Consequently, even a higher-performing teacher can provide guidance that degrades student performance. To address this, we analyze how the choice of privileged teacher affects the student's update. We derive a necessary and sufficient condition for the teacher's local distillation update to be a positive multiple of the student's reward gradient. Our analysis suggests that the teacher should not only perform well on the task, but also provide guidance suited to the student's current capabilities. This characterization motivates a practical teacher-training surrogate that combines outcome rewards with token-level Kullback-Leibler (KL) regularization toward the student. Based on this result, we propose Joint On-Policy Learning and Teaching (JOLT), which jointly trains a single policy in two roles: a privileged teacher using a KL-regularized objective, and an unprivileged student using dense on-policy distillation. Across mathematical reasoning, coding, tool use, and terminal use, JOLT improves training efficiency and performance, with further gains from student rewards.
2610.10447.paper_summary_zh: 強化學習（RL）在結果獎勵方面受到稀疏監督的困擾，特別是在成功的軌跡稀少且生成成本高的困難長期任務中。<lb/>政策內蒸餾（OPD）通過提供來自更強教師的稠密標記級監督，為學生自己的生成提供了一個有吸引力的替代方案。<lb/>自蒸餾方法進一步消除了對單獨教師模型的需求，通過對特權信息進行條件化，使同一政策充當自己的教師。<lb/>然而，僅僅依賴特權條件並不能保證所得到的蒸餾更新能改善學生的表現。<lb/>事實上，特權信息可能導致教師通過學生無法獲得的捷徑來解決任務，從而產生與學生當前行為不匹配的監督。<lb/>因此，即使是表現更好的教師也可能提供導致學生表現下降的指導。<lb/>為了解決這個問題，我們分析了特權教師的選擇如何影響學生的更新。<lb/>我們推導出教師的局部蒸餾更新成為學生獎勵梯度的正倍數的必要和充分條件。<lb/>我們的分析表明，教師不僅應該在任務上表現良好，還應提供適合學生當前能力的指導。<lb/>這一特徵促進了一種實用的教師訓練替代方案，將結果獎勵與針對學生的標記級Kullback-Leibler（KL）正則化相結合。<lb/>基於這一結果，我們提出了聯合政策學習與教學（JOLT），該方法在兩個角色中共同訓練單一政策：一個使用KL正則化目標的特權教師，和一個使用稠密政策內蒸餾的非特權學生。<lb/>在數學推理、編碼、工具使用和終端使用方面，JOLT提高了訓練效率和性能，並從學生獎勵中獲得進一步增益。
